# Quill

> Quill is a beautiful storytelling app for writers: draft chapters with AI, design book covers, publish to Kindle, build a reader following, and earn from tips and paid chapters.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Your personal writing library — start a new manuscript or continue reading.
- [Discover](/discover): Browse new books and chapters from indie writers around the world.
- [Contests](/contests): Monthly writing contests for the Quill community.
- [Feed](/feed): Latest updates from authors you follow.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Quill Pro plans — $6/month or $60/year.
- [Upgrade](/upgrade): Manage your Quill Pro subscription.
- [Marketing kit](/marketing): Posters, captions, and a promo video to share Quill.

## Optional

- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy notice.
- [Refund policy](/refund-policy): 30-day money-back guarantee.
